subject: Works in AMOS, doesn't work in R?

messages.author: d1fcdbcaa0de464d
messages.subject: Works in AMOS, doesn't work in R?
parts:
I have a SEM model that works in AMOS, but does not work in R. When I ran my syntax in R I receive the following error message

 "In estimateVCOV(lavaanModel, samplestats = lavaanSampleStats, options = lavaanOptions,  :
  lavaan WARNING: could not compute standard errors!"

I don't understand why this is happening. When I just run the measurement model in R it works and I get the same results as AMOS, but when I include my structural model it doesn't run. I pasted my syntax below. 

library(lavaan)
quant <- read.csv(file.choose())
model1 <- '
	#Measurement Model
	Latent1 =~ Par11 + Par12 + Par13
	Latent2 =~ Par21 + Par22 + Par23
	Latent3 =~ Par31 + Par32 + Par33
	Latent4 =~ Par41 + Par42 + Par43 + Par44
	Latent5 =~ Par51 + Par52 + Par53
	Latent6 =~ Par61 + Par62 + Par63
	
	#Structural Model
	Latent6 ~ Latent1 + Latent3
	Latent5 ~ Latent1 + Latent2 + Latent3
	Latent4 ~ Latent1 + Latent2 + Latent3
	Latent2 ~ Latent1
	Latent3 ~ Latent1
	'
model1Fit <- sem(model1, data=quant)



Just so you have a visual, here is my structural model

Any help on this would be greatly appreciated!
